criteria.statement: An AI research system carrying out at least two research stages
criteria.rule: Include if the record presents, evaluates or benchmarks an AI research system that carries out at least two research stages; evaluations of its outputs, such as ideas, count. The research must be scientific (natural, social, formal or health sciences). Studies that evaluate how an LLM performs one research-stage task (hypothesis generation or ranking, claim or causal-conclusion extraction from scientific literature, idea or claim evaluation) on scientific material also count. When the abstract cannot show whether a record meets IN01 or another inclusion criterion, give the verdict cannot-assess naming that criterion, which passes the record to full text; do not use unsure for this. Benchmarks, datasets and error analyses of research agents count as evaluating an AI research system.

include_cases.text: "X-Master" (SciMaster): include; a tool-augmented agent built to emulate human researchers is a research system, even though its published evaluation is a general exam (HLE).
"VAAR": include; a protocol for classifying scientific claims in hybrid human-LLM research systems covers a research stage (claim verification) within an LLM-based research system.

criteria.statement: Built on an LLM or foundation model
criteria.rule: Include if the system is built on an LLM or foundation model. 'Agent' or 'AI' alone does not show the model. When the record otherwise meets the criteria but the abstract is silent on the model, give the verdict cannot-assess naming IN02, which passes the record to full text; do not use unsure for this.

criteria.statement: First published on or after 1 January 2025
criteria.rule: Include if first published on or after 1 January 2025.

criteria.statement: The system's own research work is done in software
criteria.rule: Include if the system's own research work is done in software; later laboratory validation by humans is allowed.

criteria.statement: Not a research paper or preprint
criteria.rule: Exclude podcasts, books, news items and letters deposited on Zenodo. A title-only record is judged on its title: exclude it when the title names a non-paper (response, letter, editorial, erratum) or no AI research system; otherwise include it for full text.

criteria.statement: Survey or review of AI research systems
criteria.rule: Exclude surveys and reviews of AI research systems; kept as background only. These are recorded as background and snowball sources.
Exclude position papers that describe no system; kept as background for SQ3 only.

Exclude single-stage tools, such as a paper-writing assistant or a literature summariser, that do not run at least two research stages. A system that carries out several kinds of research task on request (analyses, literature search) is not single-stage; exclude tools built for one practical task (writing assistant, summariser, interview or data-extraction tool).

include_cases.text: "Leveraging Large-Language Models As Collaborative Reasoning Partners To Enhance Scientific Workflow": include; retrieval, reasoning over experimental data and note-taking within one research workflow is more than one stage.

"Do LLMs Know a Good Hypothesis When They See One? Logit-Based Energy Scoring for Scientific Hypothesis Ranking": include; hypothesis evaluation for AI research workflows counts even as a single component.

criteria.note: Also kept out by IN01/IN04; named so the reason is explicit.

criteria.statement: General LLM benchmark with no research workflow
criteria.rule: Exclude general LLM reasoning or coding benchmarks with no research workflow. This includes generic creativity or idea-similarity metrics evaluated without scientific material. Benchmarks of research agents are not excluded here; this criterion covers general LLM benchmarks with no research workflow.

include_cases.text: "On the Role of Model Prior in Real-World Inductive Reasoning": include; it studies how LLMs generate scientific hypotheses (a research stage), so it is not a general LLM benchmark.
"Where do deep-research agents fail" (error analysis): include; an error analysis of deep-research agents evaluates an AI research system, so it is not a general LLM benchmark.

criteria.note: Also kept out by IN01/IN04; named so the reason is explicit.

criteria.statement: One domain task with no research system
criteria.rule: Exclude papers applying an LLM to one domain task, such as a property predictor in chemistry, with no research system around it. Also exclude systems whose 'research' is engineering or commercial optimisation outside science (recommender systems, trading, cryptography and security).
criteria.note: Also kept out by IN01/IN04; named so the reason is explicit.

criteria.statement: Survey of attitudes to AI with no system
criteria.rule: Exclude surveys of scientists' attitudes to AI that describe no system or workflow.
criteria.note: Also kept out by IN01/IN04; named so the reason is explicit.

spec.rationale: Rapid review (Research Plan v1.0) of AI research systems since 2025, to compile a reference process, graded design approaches, the human role, blueprints and idea-assessment methods (SQ1-SQ5). Title/abstract screening is ranked by SPECTER2 similarity to the development seeds and stops after 30 consecutive excludes or 30 consecutive scores below 3 (lowered from 200 and 50 mid-pass A by the researcher, 2026-11-08); records left are reported in PRISMA. Screener tuning loop before main screening; band check after. Forward snowballing is capped at 15 citing works per core work, filtered by topic. Crossref is not searched (declared shortcut). Search revised after PRESS review prs_01M6VG0PYJHEW3P8J2345VPER1 (probe rounds 4 and 5): wider concept block, LLM terms in the agent block, OpenAlex English only, arXiv limited to cs.AI, cs.CL, cs.MA, cs.LG, cs.HC, cs.SE, cs.IR and cs.DL (re-review prs_01M6VGTDA6T79A5FXEEP87W51J, round 6), the same agent block on both sources, and two supplementary human-role queries. Criteria wording amended after the tuning loop (measurement batch 1).
